svg.title: Asteroid Alley layout
svg.text: ASTEROID ALLEY · Asteroid Alley · 88x56 tiles · road 5.5 tiles wide
Lap 207 tiles = 26,476 px · about 31 s per lap · closest the road comes to itself: 11.1 tiles
Glowing path = star lane (full speed). Starry space = dust (slower). Clouds / moon = slowest. Pale stretch = slippery ice.
Beacons light the tight bends. Grey rocks on dashes = drifting asteroids. Yellow streak = comet path. Orange = boost. Rock ring = wall.
Gold dashes = Rock Garden: 40 tiles, 3.5 wide, instead of 45 tiles of main lane
Gold dashes = Crater Cut: 28 tiles, 3.5 wide, instead of 39 tiles of main lane
